name: anvil
description: Shape work on the anvil: a non-invasive, operator-scoped pipeline that turns an idea into a near-mergeable PR without watching the session. Plan and lock a spec, run a critic panel, adjudicate the cruxes, then dispatch → review → auto-fix over a beads ready-frontier. Nothing is committed into your repo or its CLAUDE.md.

interface.shortDescription: Operator-scoped plan → critique → adjudicate → dispatch pipeline
